email.subject: Classic City Rotary Weekly: Focus on Local Education & Service Opportunities
email.body:
Dear Fellow Rotarians,

I hope you are all having a productive week. As we look ahead to our next meeting at the Trumps Design Center, I want to highlight several upcoming service projects that align with our club's commitment to supporting K-12 education in Athens-Clarke County.

1. Literacy Mentorship Program: We are looking for six volunteers to assist with the morning reading hour at Barnett Shoals Elementary starting next Tuesday. This is a direct way to impact early literacy rates in our community.

2. Cedar Shoals High School STEM Fair: The school is seeking professional mentors to help students refine their project presentations on October 25th. Given our club's diverse professional background, your expertise would be invaluable.

3. School Supplies Top-up: While the school year is well underway, several teachers at Coile Middle School have reported a shortage of basic supplies. We will be collecting donations at this Friday's breakfast meeting.

Service Above Self,

Elena Rodriguez
Club Secretary, Classic City Rotary

email.subject: Classic City Rotary Weekly: Focus on Local Education & Service Opportunities
email.body:
Dear Fellow Rotarians,

I hope you are all having a productive week. As we look ahead to our next meeting at the Trumps Design Center, I want to highlight several upcoming service projects that align with our club's commitment to supporting K-12 education in Athens-Clarke County.

1. Literacy Mentorship Program: We are looking for six volunteers to assist with the morning reading hour at Barnett Shoals Elementary starting next Tuesday. This is a direct way to impact early literacy rates in our community.

2. Cedar Shoals High School STEM Fair: The school is seeking professional mentors to help students refine their project presentations on October 25th. Given our club's diverse professional background, your expertise would be invaluable.

3. School Supplies Top-up: While the school year is well underway, several teachers at Coile Middle School have reported a shortage of basic supplies. We will be collecting donations at this Friday's breakfast meeting.

Service Above Self,

Elena Rodriguez
Club Secretary, Classic City Rotary

email.subject: Agenda and Materials: December 5th Historic Preservation Commission Meeting
email.body:
Dear Commissioners,

Please find the agenda and supporting materials for our December meeting tonight, December 5th, at 6:30 PM. We will convene in the Multipurpose Room of the Athens-Clarke County Library.

Key Agenda Items:
1. Approval of November 7th Meeting Minutes
2. COA Review: 220 South Milledge Ave - Foundation stabilization and porch repair
3. Old Business: Finalizing the Middle Oconee River Archaeological Sensitivity Map (GIS layers update)
4. Subcommittee Reports: Dr. Miller, we look forward to your update on the 2024 Curation Standards draft.
5. New Business: 2024 Meeting Schedule Approval

Staff reports for the Milledge Avenue property are attached. Please review the archaeological map edits beforehand so we can vote on final adoption.

See you tonight,

Brad Fields
Senior Planner, ACC Planning Department
